description:
Cast Ojer Taq by paying its mana cost.
When Ojer Taq enters, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ojer Taq with haste plus at least one additional token due to Ojer Taq's effect.
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}.
When Kirol enters, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, use the ability of Enduring Vitality to tap one of the Ojer Taq tokens, adding {1}.
Activate Kirol by tapping two creatures, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, creating at least eight tokens due to the multiple copies of Ojer Taq.
Holding priority, use the ability of Enduring Vitality to tap one of the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.name: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
